ns2:section.sectionText: STUDENTS INTERESTED IN NEWS-EDITORIAL JOURNALISM SHOULD CONSIDER THIS SECTION. Students who have completed JOUR 400 should not register for JOUR 210. While the number is different, the course content is the same. Registering for the new course would be seen as duplicate credit. Duplicate credit does not count toward graduation and students registering for the duplicate course will be asked to drop. Note: Pre-req for this course will be enforced. Non-Journalism majors that have been accepted into the PR Certificate program AND that have completed JOUR 200 should visit http://illinois.edu/fb/sec/4727686 to indicate their interest in this and other required PR Cert. courses. Space is limited and seats will be granted on a first come/first served basis only. If you have not completed JOUR 200, you will be dropped from the course.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Agr & Environmental Cmc & Educ or Journalism or News-Editorial or Agricultural Communications major(s).
